entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: full portrait background for a fixed-camera watercolor Chinese animal sanctuary game. Input image is the exact approved master AND the edit target. Return one full portrait image with exactly the same framing and aspect ratio. Change ONLY the existing upper-left medical hut, in rectangle x=0..40%, y=25..46% of the canvas. Keep its exact roof silhouette, scale, footprint, foundation, steps, perspective and placement. Keep ALL mountains, clouds, sky, trees, flowers, fences, every path stone, koi pond, the other THREE facilities, and their lighting and positions unchanged. No cropping or zoom. No new buildings, no people, animals, text, UI, border or watermark. This is a subtle localized story restoration state, not a new architecture design. CLINIC STORY PHASE 0: abandoned before sweeping. The existing hut still stands in its exact shape, but the wood and roof have dull weathering, small cobwebs and dust; a few old fallen leaves cover the doorway and the existing steps. Inside the open doorway the medicine cabinet has a few crooked or missing drawers. A small existing medicine stove/cauldron is cold and dark, no flame, no steam, no interior golden window glow. Keep the same hanging outside lantern object, but unlit. Do not make it a collapsed ruin or change its foundation. Preserve the reference theme's ambient color and light, including all other existing lanterns; only the clinic interior is unlit.
